description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the challenge + header pair is well-formed for grading; no field is matched and no verdict is returned. The full signed report is the paid receipt_verify call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

challenge.description: The captured 402 challenge object exactly as issued by the endpoint that was paid. Processed in memory only, never stored.

paymentResponse.description: The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header value from the paid call (base64 JSON string; a raw JSON string or the decoded object are also accepted). Processed in memory only, never stored.

name: receipt_precheck
